_why: #27. The gate was single-surface on a feature where codex carried 25 of 27 disagreements. Each mutation carries its own `test` key.

mutations.name: a-truncated-transcript-counts-as-complete
mutations._mechanism: #24's lesson one level down. A transcript with no trailing token total was killed or copied mid-write; calling it complete republishes the false zero #24 removed.

mutations.name: a-non-codex-file-gets-a-zero-row
mutations._mechanism: The mode-15 trap: a dict of zeros is a MEASUREMENT of a file this instrument cannot read. None is refusal and must stay refusal.

mutations.name: the-outcome-anchor-loses-its-leading-space
mutations._mechanism: The leading space is what keeps the primary instrument out of the echoed prompt. Dropped, it matches nothing real -- the control transcript that DID read the tree scores 0 and reads as hollow.

mutations.name: the-cross-check-always-agrees
mutations._mechanism: Two instruments that disagree are a fact about the transcript. Hardcoding agreement turns the cross-check into decoration and hides a format change.
